function: Learned encoder and decoder (autoencoder) for spatial modulation; the decoder jointly detects the data symbol and the active transmit antenna index from the received signal and CSI (p. 4).
system: MISO spatial modulation, Nt=2 transmit antennas (c=1 bit) and one receive antenna, quasi-static Rician fading plus AWGN, no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 9, 11).
method: Fully connected autoencoder (encoder and decoder networks), trained end to end and centralized with cross-entropy loss and symbol labels; paper calls the autoencoder unsupervised (pp. 2, 8).
data_channel: Simulated: random 3-bit symbols and quasi-static Rician fading from MATLAB comm.MIMOchannel plus AWGN; 100,000 samples split 80/10/10 for training, validation, testing (p. 8).
test_conditions: Separate model per Rician factor (3, 10, 20 dB), trained at fixed Eb/N0 (7 or 15 dB) and tested on held-out data over an Eb/N0 sweep (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Non-learned: PSK-based spatial modulation with maximum-likelihood detection and perfect CSI. Learned: only the paper's own framework 1 (plain autoencoder); no earlier learned scheme compared (p. 9).
metrics: Block error rate versus Eb/N0, Eb/N0 required for BLER 1e-3 (power efficiency), and number of bits transmitted (bandwidth) (p. 9, Table X on p. 11).
complexity: none; only a qualitative low-complexity claim (p. 2) and layer sizes of 64 nodes (Table IX, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "quasistatic Rician fading channel gains for each sample" generated with MATLAB comm.MIMOchannel; a custom Rician simulator, not 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "For every test case considered, a number of models for each AE framework are trained"; one model per Rician factor (p. 9), tested on held-out data of the same set, with only an Eb/N0 sweep.
q3_support: p. 9: "compared to that of a baseline PSK-based SM with MLD and perfect CSI at the receiver"; the only learned comparator is the paper's own framework 1 (p. 2: "In this proposed AE framework"), a variant of the proposed method; no earlier learned scheme is compared.
q4_support: p. 2: "as a low complexity solution" is a qualitative claim only; no operations, parameter count or runtime is reported, and Table IX (p. 9) lists only layer sizes.
q5_support: p. 8: "The data set is generated by generating random k-bit symbols" with simulated channels; no code or data link is given, and no public dataset or measured data is used.
notes: Included as area 1: the decoder recovers data symbol and antenna index (BLER is the main metric), and the encoder learns the modulation jointly. The link is 2x1 MISO, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. Framework 1 is the plain autoencoder of the paper itself, so it is not an earlier learned baseline. Related ML works of Table I (p. 3) are not compared in simulation. Tables III, VII to X and Fig. 7 were read from the PDF pages 5, 8 to 11.
